newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian govt, Duma agree on 1997 draft budget.
newsitem.headline: Russian govt, Duma agree on 1997 draft budget.

text.p: Russian government officials and parliamentarians agreed on Wednesday on new outlines for the 1997 draft budget.

A reconciliation commission of representatives from the Russian government and both houses of parliament cut both spending and revenue figures from the government's original draft, but allowed a small rise in the deficit.

The State Duma lower house rejected the government's original draft last month, criticising overambitious revenue projections and inadequate social spending, and ordered the government to prepare a new version, to be examined by the reconcilation commission.
The commission plans to present the new draft to the State Duma lower house for a first reading on November 20.
